source_scope.source_detail_limit: Four workflow assets have same-name DDL. The advertised agent table creates ods_dwd_risk_ai_apps_df and the advertised realtime request log is detailed as incremental di. Ten ytoken assets have overview names only. An unadvertised account heading creates ods_ai_workflow_app_log_df and exposes password fields; it receives no denominator credit.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Same-name DDL plus explicit AI application, immutable workflow version, run, node attempt, invocation, Identity, token/quota ledger, model offering, image evidence and Skill marketplace boundaries.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Non-empty production full-denominator reconciliation with exact tenant, Principal, application/workflow/version/run/node/invocation/provider/model/pricing/credential/quota/ledger/asset/Skill identities, immutable payload digests and independently accepted business effects.

lifecycle_policy_defaults.history_policy: Applications, workflow definitions, models, pricing and Skills publish immutable versions; runs, node attempts, invocations, usage, quota ledger, top-ups, downloads and generated assets append.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.delete_policy: Disable/retire revokes future use while retaining audit, billing, decision and evidence lineage; credentials are revoked, never exposed or reconstructed.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.backfill_policy: Resolve tenant, Principal, application, workflow/version, model offering/pricing, credential metadata, quota account, invocation and asset identities; quarantine raw secrets, unversioned graphs, ambiguous realtime/incremental names and unsupported financial semantics.

name_conflict_assets.source_label: 客服大模型请求日志表
name_conflict_assets.target_boundary: Restricted AI invocation request/result with exact Ticket/business case, application/workflow/model/provider identities, versioned payload schema and separately accepted Customer Service decision
name_conflict_assets.conflict_rule: Do not equate realtime ri and incremental di names; require physical source, CDC mode, business key and full-denominator reconciliation before credit.

name_conflict_assets.target_boundary: Tenant-scoped AI Application plus immutable workflow assignment and lifecycle, distinct from Risk application projection
name_conflict_assets.conflict_rule: Do not treat ods_dwd_risk_ai_apps_df as the advertised ODS AI application or infer an alias from similar fields.

overview_only_groups.authority: Identity owns Principal; Authentication owns login observations; Token Platform stores credential metadata, grants and revocation while a secret vault owns secret material.
overview_only_groups.security: Passwords, API keys, bearer tokens, raw email/IP/device/session and credential payloads are forbidden from canonical events and broad analytics.

assets.table_rule: Require immutable authentication outcome/method/session evidence and tokenized actor/device data; login is not credential authority.
Map source user to canonical Principal without importing credentials or collapsing profile, quota and billing accounts.
Treat as credential configuration metadata only after schema proves key type, scope, vault reference, lifecycle and revocation; raw token is rejected.
Model a Principal-to-credential grant with scope, validity and revocation; never expose or hash-match raw bearer tokens as identity.

overview_only_groups.authority: Token Platform owns quota and immutable usage ledger; Payment owns settled top-up money; model pricing is an immutable version; aggregate logs never replace double-entry or conservation checks.
overview_only_groups.security: Payment references, provider request ids and cost details are restricted; no raw instrument or credential material is accepted.

assets.table_rule: Require ISO currency/minor unit, Payment settlement reference, quota unit, pricing/conversion version and immutable ledger conservation; a top-up row alone is not payment success.
Bind each usage fact to exact invocation, model offering, pricing version, credential metadata and quota ledger entry; reject aggregate-only deduction.

overview_only_groups.authority: Token Platform owns model offerings/pricing; AI Operations owns generation evidence; secure storage owns bytes; Skill Marketplace owns signed package versions and entitlements, never executable trust by download count.
overview_only_groups.security: Generated images/prompts, package artifacts, manifests, signatures, malware reports, license/author data and download identities require restricted storage and supply-chain verification.

assets.table_rule: Separate immutable provider/model offering identity, capabilities, lifecycle and effective-dated pricing; display names are not model ids.
Store generation invocation plus secure object/digest/moderation/licensing evidence; raw prompts and URLs remain restricted.
Require immutable package version, manifest, publisher identity, signature, permissions, dependency lock, license and security scan before marketplace admission.
Record download entitlement and signed package digest; download does not grant runtime permissions, approval or trust.

unadvertised_detailed_findings.finding: The non-overview account heading creates a log-named table and includes password and password_salt; reject credential ingestion and require a qualified Identity source plus vault-held credential lifecycle.
